name: Unidentified Ore
summary: At Windshear Crag, Unidentified Ore has drawn the Venture Company's attention. Piznik recovered a sample and gave it to Ziz Fizziks for study in Undermine.

sections.title: A Curious Strike in Windshear
sections.body:
The Venture Company has exposed unusual mineral strata in the Stonetalon Mountains through clear-cutting and strip mining at Windshear Crag. Its new boss, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, ordered large amounts of strange gold-green ore mined.

Demoted goblin worker Piznik stayed loyal to his fired former boss, Ziz Fizziks. He secured a sample while planning his escape from the outfit, then gave it to a traveler bound for the crag's western ridge. Ziz plans to send most of the ore to Undermine for study and keep a small cut for himself.

faq.answer: Venture Company miners dug up the Unidentified Ore at Windshear Crag. Its composition interests Ziz Fizziks and mining engineers in Undermine.
Piznik, a Venture Company goblin stationed at Windshear Crag, salvaged the sample. After recent mishaps, he feared punishment from company supervisors and saw a chance to flee and find new work.

faq.q: Who is trying to study this sample?
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks, a goblin camped along the western edge of Windshear Crag, received the mineral. He plans to send most of it to engineers in Undermine and keep a small portion for himself.

faq.q: Why does Undermine care about this stone?
faq.answer: Goblins search for new explosive, metallurgical, or combustible materials. A strange mineral from Kalimdor's ancient mountains could have industrial and commercial value for the trade cartels.

angles.text: Miners find ordinary veins throughout Windshear Crag, but this sample defies common trade knowledge. Even Undermine's best appraisers are intrigued.
Goblincraft seeks raw compounds with unique reactive properties. Unclassified ores from untamed crags give innovative tinkers material to study.
